_field_sources.tls: capture: original 2026-05-06 passive collector run; artifact path /tmp/fingerprint-data/anthropic-tls/* was not committed and is now lost; pending full re-capture per W11-F-F1-status.md §12.6 (Owner 2026-05-26: 全部重抓计划). TLS field values (ja3/ja4/ciphers/extensions/etc.) below are the only surviving record of that run.
_field_sources.alpn_protocols: PARTIAL — value ["http/1.1"] is inherited from the lost 2026-05-06 TLS capture (no surviving artifact path). Option (b) capture tools/fingerprint-collector/captures/h2-server-1779775310.jsonl (start ts 2026-05-26T06:01:50Z UTC) only proves CC CLI did NOT advertise h2 in its ClientHello ALPN (5 connections × alpn_negotiated=null against h2-only server). It does NOT distinguish 'CC offered exactly ["http/1.1"]' from 'CC offered no ALPN extension at all' — both produce the same null result. Driving client: claude.exe (Claude Code CLI v2.1.112) as subprocess via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://127.0.0.1:18099 + NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=tools/fingerprint-collector/tls_cert/server.crt; method: tools/fingerprint-collector/h2_capture_server.py --max-connections 5. Direct verification of the exact ALPN list pending full re-capture (Owner 2026-05-26: 全部重抓计划) with a ClientHello-parsing capture server that records the OFFERED ALPN values, not just the NEGOTIATED result.
_field_sources.h2_settings: capture: same source as alpn_protocols above. Because CC CLI never negotiated h2 in any of 5 connections, no HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame was sent; h2_settings.available=false matches first-party reality (not a measurement gap).
_field_sources.method_notes: h2_capture_server.py terminates TLS with self-signed cert + ALPN=h2 only; verified working against undici (captures/h2-server-1779761396.jsonl) and httpx (captures/h2-server-1779774012.jsonl) both negotiating h2 successfully — server-side ALPN advertisement is functional, the null result is therefore client-side absence of h2 ALPN.

h2_settings.limitation_note: collector v1 无 TLS 解密材料，HTTP/2 SETTINGS 为空是预期行为。
